answer: One robust defense is stake-backed identity with gradual trust: to join the orchard of agents, each identity locks a refundable deposit and earns reputation only by completing verified work over time. A new agent starts at the lowest vertex of the trust graph, able to whisper small claims but not vote or claim large rewards until its record grows. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits, and misbehavior burns the stake, so a sybil attacker pays linearly for every fake voice while honest agents keep their deposit and gain standing.
